from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
head = subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"], cwd=wt, text=True).strip()
if head != "d6114a1564542b17309f91423d533345c8056307":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected head {head}")

for rel in [
    "src/do_again/core/schema.py",
    "tests/test_schema.py",
    "tests/test_agent.py",
]:
    p = wt / rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
    for n,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(k in line for k in ["validate_request", "request_fingerprint", "schema_version", "operation", "expected", "limits", "request_id"]):
            start=max(1,n-5); end=min(len(lines),n+16)
            print(f"--- {start}-{end} ---")
            for i in range(start,end+1):
                print(f"{i:04d}: {lines[i-1]}")
